text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how shall I tackle this? From 
the front, or from behind? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rival A
text_block_list.text: Rulership...!

text_block_list.name: Rival B
text_block_list.text:
Not to be underestimated... Keep an eye on 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. ...Don't get so worked up. No matter 
how big the stage, a race is just a 
race... right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Right, if I control the pace and calm 
things down around me—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(An extreme pace is unlikely. No matter 
how sharp Flash-san's late burst may 
be...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Right here—the showdown!! Die Zeit ist 
gekommen.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I can't... reach?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, indeed, indeed! You fell right 
into my trap!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There is no way you could win from this 
position...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Huh-huh? At this rate, isn't it 
impossible for even me to win?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOH, you gotta be kidding meee~!!! 
Somebody do somethinggg~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... it's too late. Having focused 
so much on sealing away Eishin Flash, 
Rulership missed the chance for victory.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... "The clever schemer drowns in their 
own scheme"—a fitting description indeed—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Is this really the time to be saying 
that?! What on earth are you doooing...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
After planning everything so meticulously, 
appearing on media outlets I hated, and 
training so hard...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~, no, no, I hate this! If there was a 
hole I'd crawl right into it, and if I had 
a house I'd run straight home~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Ruler-san. That was 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh, impressive...? I didn't even win, you 
know...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, when I said splendid, I wasn't 
referring to the result. I meant your—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is praise for precise work.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Precise... work?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Looking back... I felt like today's 
race was being controlled by you. Most 
likely...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"You were the only one who could see the 
whole race, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even if we couldn't grasp victory, this 
Derby was...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I almost feel as though this is a 
masterpiece born of your exquisite 
craftsmanship."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You too—no, precisely because you were 
there for me—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe this Derby had the potential to 
become the greatest in history.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san... Y-You think so...? Well, 
maybe that is the case~.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Let us gather around the table 
again. After all, our game has only just 
begun.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Yes.
"Our game has only just begun"... huh...
Ooooh~~~, that's so cool~~~!!

The Umamusume watching nearby were also 
completely captivated by their exchange.

And so, the curtain fell on the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Traaaiineer~... I overdid it waaaay too 
much~~~. My whole body is totally falling 
apart...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My HP and MP are both at zero, so I kinda 
don't wanna do anything for a while...
choice_data_list:
You really did great out there. Here, have 
some snacks and juice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this really hits the spot... Long 
live junk food...!

"Not only did she use her head, but she 
also pushed her body to the absolute limit 
in this 'Japanese Derby'. It's no wonder 
she's completely exhausted."

However, the bare minimum decisions still 
had to be made.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The next... goal... Guhhh...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... Needless to say, we are 
giving the Kikuka Sho a hard pass.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Because I've cut out all of my 
long-distance training entirely.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Give me as long an interval as possible, 
and pick a race where the competition 
isn't too tough, please.

"...If we're not running in the 'Kikuka 
Sho', there's no need to rush so much. 
Which means..."
choice_data_list:
How about something like the Challenge Cup 
in early December?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "The Challenge Cup... A 2,000m GIII, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Right. First, let's make sure you've 
completely recovered from the fatigue, and 
we'll restart from there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And so... that's enough gaming for now. 
Catch ya later, logging off...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanna hole up in my room... But 
even going home... is too much of a 
drag..."
choice_data_list:
Here, lie on the sofa. I've got your usual 
pillow, too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Zzzzzzzzz... Snnnnooooore...!"

She must have been completely exhausted. 
She collapsed straight into sleep, but...
choice_data_list: Fall will be a new game again
Fall will be a new game again, huh?

text_block_list.text:
Savoring the lingering afterglow of the 
greatest Derby in history, they moved on 
toward the next season.
